initialSampleWaiter.text:
Juniper & Rye is a fictional sample, so its Italian-seasonal profile and illustrative $48 per person price are placeholders. They fit your reported Italian and Seasonal tastes and sit under your $65 minimum budget, but a sample can't confirm real costs, menus, or availability.

One useful next step: refresh discovery to see real restaurant candidates that match Italian and Seasonal. Then compare those, and once you pick one, use the app's explicit plan controls to save it. Keep in mind a saved plan is not a confirmed reservation, so you'd still need to contact the restaurant directly for availability and any dietary questions.

realVenueWaiter.text:
Here is what the supplied record supports for Hungry Ghost: it is a real restaurant from the catalog, listed as a coffee shop. Beyond that, nothing is verified. I have no confirmed exact cost, menu, hours, walking time, reservation availability, or allergy safety, and the price level is blank, so I can't say whether it fits your $65 minimum budget. Your saved tastes are Italian and Seasonal, and a coffee shop listing doesn't tell me whether either applies. I also can't say whether it works for a dinner at all.

Before choosing it, confirm directly with the restaurant:
1. Whether it serves dinner, its hours, and whether it takes reservations for your date.
2. What the menu looks like, whether it matches Italian or seasonal, and what a meal costs per person.

If you'd rather compare options that fit Italian and seasonal, refresh discovery. Your dinner plan isn't saved yet, and saving one wouldn't be a reservation either way.
